title: How do we simplify these six expressions?
description: Six expressions with many terms and some brackets are simplified by opening each bracket and joining like terms. A minus sign before a bracket changes every sign inside it.
teaching_notes: One idea: open the bracket first, then join terms with the same letter and the plain numbers. Watch for students who forget to change the second sign inside a bracket that has a minus sign before it.

video_script.why: A learner uses the method of opening a bracket: the number or sign before the bracket acts on every term inside it, and then like terms are joined.
video_script.substitution: The method of opening a bracket such as two times the bracket y minus one, with the six expressions in place of the matchstick formula.
video_script.anchor: six expressions with many terms, some of them with brackets
video_script.payoff_line: All six expressions are now in their simplest form

final_answer.spoken: four eigh plus five b plus ten; eigh minus thirteen b minus sixteen; twelve x plus six; six x plus fifteen; h plus four; twenty one m minus twenty n plus five

never_show: the simplified forms before their steps
video_script.design: One idea: open the bracket, then join like terms. Assumes the example of opening a bracket. The six expressions stay on the stage and are done one at a time.
open_questions: The book prints (f) as 21m − 20n + 5; the video says it in the same order.

narration: <bookmark mark='gv1'/>Given, six expressions in the letters eigh, b, x, h, m and n. Some of them have brackets.

beats.on_screen: To find: each expression in its simplest form
narration: <bookmark mark='fd'/>We simplify all six. We work the same way as the example in your book.
<bookmark mark='s1a'/>First, the expression with no bracket. Add the eigh terms: three eigh plus eight eigh minus seven eigh is four eigh.
<bookmark mark='s1b'/>The b terms give nine b minus four b, which is five b.
<bookmark mark='s1c'/>The numbers give minus six plus sixteen, which is ten. The result is four eigh plus five b plus ten.
<bookmark mark='s2a'/>Second, open the bracket in the second one. Three times three eigh is nine eigh, and three times minus three b is minus nine b.
<bookmark mark='s2b'/>Nine eigh minus eight eigh is eigh. Minus nine b minus four b is minus thirteen b. The result is eigh minus thirteen b minus sixteen.
<bookmark mark='s3a'/>Third, open the bracket in the third one. Two times the bracket two x minus three is four x minus six.
<bookmark mark='s3b'/>Four x plus eight x is twelve x, and minus six plus twelve is six. The result is twelve x plus six.

marks.s4a: the minus sign flips every sign inside the bracket
marks.s4c: the bracket in (e) is opened with signs flipped

narration: <bookmark mark='s4a'/>Fourth, the minus sign before a bracket changes every sign inside it. <bookmark mark='s4e'/>In the fourth one, minus the bracket two x minus three becomes minus two x plus three.
<bookmark mark='s4b'/>Eight x minus two x is six x, and three plus twelve is fifteen. The result is six x plus fifteen.
<bookmark mark='s4c'/>In the fifth one, minus the bracket five plus seven h becomes minus five minus seven h.
<bookmark mark='s4d'/>Eight h minus seven h is h. Minus five plus nine is four. The result is h plus four.
<bookmark mark='s5a'/>Fifth, the last one has four times the bracket six m minus three n. That gives twenty four m minus twelve n.
<bookmark mark='s5b'/>The m terms give twenty four m minus three m, which is twenty one m. <bookmark mark='s5d'/>The n terms give minus twelve n minus eight n, which is minus twenty n.
<bookmark mark='s5c'/>The numbers give twenty three minus eighteen, which is five. The result is twenty one m minus twenty n plus five.

marks.s6a: 1 replaces x in the third and fourth expressions
marks.s6b: the third expression gives 18 both ways
marks.s6c: the fourth expression gives 21 both ways

narration: <bookmark mark='s6a'/>Sixth, check the third and fourth with x as one.
<bookmark mark='s6b'/>The third gives minus two plus eight plus twelve, which is eighteen. Twelve plus six is eighteen as well.
<bookmark mark='s6c'/>The fourth gives eight plus one plus twelve, which is twenty one. Six plus fifteen is also twenty one.
<bookmark mark='ans'/>All six expressions are now in their simplest form.
<bookmark mark='ans2'/>They are four eigh plus five b plus ten, and eigh minus thirteen b minus sixteen.
<bookmark mark='ans3'/>Next are twelve x plus six, and six x plus fifteen.
<bookmark mark='ans4'/>The last two are h plus four, and twenty one m minus twenty n plus five.
